tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: ROBOTio catalogue: humanoid robots for rent with operators, what they do at events, starting prices, terms, references and contact.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether ROBOTio has humanoid robots free on a date (or date range). Returns available, limited or unavailable. The date is only held after a quote request and payment.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request to ROBOTio on behalf of the user. ROBOTio replies by e-mail within 24 hours. Before sending, show the user a summary and send only after they explicitly agree to share their name and e-mail. This is a non-binding request, not a booking.
